It is encouraging to hear that your mood has improved after TMS, but it is completely understandable to feel frustrated that your energy and motivation haven't caught up yet. It is actually quite common for the physical and cognitive symptoms of depression, like fatigue and low motivation, to take a little longer to resolve even after the emotional heaviness starts to lift. 

To address these lingering symptoms, a great next step is to discuss them with your psychiatrist or doctor. They might suggest adjusting current medications, checking for underlying physical factors like vitamin deficiencies, or exploring therapies like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Specifically, a technique called behavioral activation can be very helpful for gently rebuilding routines and motivation. In the meantime, try to be patient with yourself. Focus on setting very small, manageable goals each day and celebrate those minor victories while your brain and body continue to heal.
